correctness.rationale: For each n≥3, fixed edge labels R_i,T_i,B_i give a bijective cyclic word encoding. Direct endpoint inspection reduces pairwise induced-matching compatibility to adjacent-column emptiness and five permitted directed pairs at separation two; cyclic closure enforces both orientations when appropriate. The seven-state graph has one weighted closed walk per feasible word. Signed-permutation calculation of det(I-tT) gives (1+zt²)(1-t-2zt²-zt³+z²t⁴), and formal log derivative yields the polynomial after subtracting the two auxiliary traces. Exact gap classification gives floor(n/2) and n² versus 6/2 maximum counts. A new standalone standard-library program performs an exact polynomial determinant, graph-level enumeration of 349,504 words for n=3..9, transfer checks, and extremal checks n=3..44. All checks passed; arbitrary n follows from proof, not finite data.

originality.rationale: The closest full-text source Mathar arXiv:2404.18806 gives all open rectangular-board non-bonding domino counts, including width two, but not longitudinally cyclic prisms. Its open four-column coefficient vector differs from the prism vector. Joos et al. arXiv:1312.1110 state general cubic induced-matching lower bounds, not enumerators; generalized Petersen strong edge-coloring and ordinary prism matching tables count different quantities. Named search/comparison checks document residual risk of an uncatalogued cylindrical-strip formula.

A published generic cylindrical transfer matrix might imply the closed formula after specialization even without identical wording.
A 2020 prism perfect-matching paper was identified but its full text could not be inspected; its subject is ordinary perfect matchings, a different class of sets.

value.rationale: The cycle prism is the canonical cubic cyclic closure of a two-column ladder. Its exact induced-matching distribution differs from the known open-board polynomial and from ordinary prism matching data; closure alters both coefficients and maximum-set behavior. The parity-sensitive exact multiplicity classification n² in odd order and 6/2 in even order is a complete natural extremal invariant, with a motivated consequence for enumerating independent edge packings on periodic strips. This is not an arbitrary small-board datum or a restatement of a generic size bound.
